1. Open the compass/magnetometer calibration screen in your ground station.
2. Follow the prompts to rotate the vehicle slowly through all orientations — typically each face down, nose down, nose up, on each side, and upside down, holding each position until the software registers it.
3. Save the calibration when prompted.
4. Retry arming.

Do this outdoors, away from metal structures, vehicles, and power lines, since magnetic interference will produce a bad calibration.
